The collapse of the ancient bridge serves as the inciting incident that drives the plot forward by isolating the villagers and forcing them to adapt. This event shifts the narrative from a state of dependence on the neighboring town to one of self-reliance, catalyzing character development through the emergence of unexpected leadership and community cohesion. Ultimately, the disaster transforms the society's structure, moving it toward greater independence and unity.

Regarding your question, the animal typically regarded as man's best friend is the dog.
